en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Before I left the academy...
I decided to talk alone with Kaede.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the last day we'll spend
at this academy...

<CLT=cltMIND>This school life was crazy, but now that
I think back on it, we had some good times.
It's finally our last day here...

I'm definitely happy, but...I'm sorta
disappointed...

I just kept thinking about...
the worst possible situation.
Yes...but I'm glad nothing happened.

Actually, believe it or not, right now
I'm almost glad I was brought here.

Huh? But why?
Did something good happen?

A lot of good things happened.
I met you, Kaede...

You say really embarrassing things so
easily, Shuichi...
Ah, y-you think so?

A-Anyway, do you still remember?
You know...about coming over to my house?
Of course.

I was thinking about going over
for a visit as soon as we get out.

Then, you remember what you're doing
once you come over, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>What we're going to do
at Kaede's house...
Meet her parents
Take Kaede's piano
Practice the piano duet
I'm going to meet your parents, right?

I wanted to introduce you to my parents, too...
But that wasn't it.

Also, meeting my parents...
might be a bit too fast...
Th-That's true... Sorry.

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
What was I going to do at her house?
Take your piano, right?
We never talked about that!

The piano at my house is my partner!
I would never give it to you!

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
What was I going to do at her house?

Practice the piano duet.
See how much I've improved.

Yeah, we played a lot with the piano here,
but I want us to play on *my* piano.

I want to see how well we can sync
our timing...our breathing...

I want you to listen to the sound of
my piano.

I'm sure that a piano *that* important
to you makes a beautiful sound, Kaede.

It's not like it costed a million dollars or
anything, but the quality is still top-notch.
Wh-Why are you quiet all of a sudden?

Ah, I was just thinking about how
happy I was to meet you, Kaede.

If I never met you, I never would have
found the beauty of piano...

I would never know how much fun it
is to play or the richness of its sound...

I'm so happy that you showed me
those things, Kaede.
But I'm not done yet.
What?

I haven't taught you all the amazing
things about the piano yet!
I'll be your tutor and teach you everything!
We have all the time in the world now...
...right?
<CLT=cltMIND>...Yeah. You're right.

<CLT=cltMIND>We have all the time in the world.
Once we're free.

<CLT=cltMIND>And I want to spend
every second of it with you.
<CLT=cltMIND>There might be bad times, sure...

<CLT=cltMIND>I know that it won't always
be easy.

<CLT=cltMIND>But I know...that I'm looking forward
to my <CLT=cltSTRONG>future<CLT=cltMIND> with Kaede.

<CLT=cltMIND>And I know that she
feels the same way.

<CLT=cltMIND>We may not have said it in words, but...
I feel like we didn't need to.

<CLT=cltMIND>And thus, our days at the
Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles...
<CLT=cltMIND>came to an end.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme,
"Love Across the Universe."
